summary: Russia has received another batch of North Korean ballistic missiles and is preparing to deploy North Korean troops, per Zelensky. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system, logistics warehouses in Rovenky, a command post in Belgorod, and six UAV control points. Russia launched three Zircon hypersonic missiles at Kyiv's Zhuliany area and is scaling production of faster Geran-4 strike drones.
key_points: Russia received North Korean ballistic missiles and prepares North Korean troop deployment, per Zelensky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32350)

HUR confirms Russian mobilization preparation for autumn after parliamentary elections. (Source: @UkraineNow/83365)

sections.executive_summary: Russia has received another batch of North Korean ballistic missiles and is preparing to deploy North Korean troops, per Zelensky. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system, logistics warehouses in Rovenky, a command post in Belgorod, and six UAV control points. Russia launched three Zircon hypersonic missiles at Kyiv's Zhuliany area and is scaling production of faster Geran-4 strike drones.

points: Zelensky publicly warned that Russia has received another batch of ballistic missiles from North Korea and is preparing to receive a contingent of North Korean troops, indicating deepening military cooperation between Moscow and Pyongyang. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32350)

Former Commander-in-Chief Zaluzhny stated Ukraine must focus exclusively on war for the next 50 years, dismissing economic priorities as charlatanism and tying national future solely to security. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32373)

Former Foreign Minister Kuleba assessed that the ballistic missile interception problem will not be resolved in 2026, saying Ukraine can only hope strikes pressure Putin into action. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32375)

Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Buk-M3 air defense system, materiel warehouses in Rovenky (Luhansk), a command post in Belgorod region, and six UAV control points, per HUR confirmation. (Source: @UkraineNow/83354)

Ukraine destroyed 195,000 enemy fixed-wing drones and 66,000 copters since January, with a 46% increase in fixed-wing kills May-July and 42% copter increase June-July, all verified by DELTA system. (Source: @UkraineNow/83357)

Ukrainian air defense ceased publishing Russian missile launch data due to critical interceptor shortages after failing to intercept any missiles during the August 5 attack wave. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32372)

Ukrainian diplomats are actively seeking Patriot PAC-3 interceptors from Spain, Greece, and other holders, but progress depends on US political will which remains insufficient per a high-ranking official. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32360)
Russia has received another batch of North Korean ballistic missiles and is preparing to receive a contingent of North Korean troops, per Zelensky's warning. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32350)

Russia has frozen Geran-3 production to scale Geran-4 drones: speed up to 500 km/h, range up to 550 km, warhead 50-90 kg, cost $170-200k, often used with manual camera guidance. (Source: @mon1tor_eng/70071)
Russian forces struck Kyiv with three Zircon hypersonic missiles targeting the Zhuliany area, causing warehouse fires in the Shevchenkivskyi district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat reported from Taganrog, Rostov region, per monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70067)
HUR confirmed Russian mobilization preparation for autumn following so-called parliamentary elections in Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83365)
Russian forces struck a Nova Poshta terminal and San-Park transport logistics center in Kyiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32353)
Border region residents suffer daily deaths and injuries from AFU attacks, per Chechen commander Alaudinov. (Source: @tass_agency/389871)
Fighting continues at Krasny Liman with Ukrainian forces counterattacking from Redkodub north of the town. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
Ukrainian forces are attempting to counterattack Toretsk, which Russian troops previously captured, per the Druzhkovka front summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
Russian aviation struck areas of Ukrainian Armed Forces personnel concentration in Kherson region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Drone attacks occurred across Zaporizhzhia region districts including Melitopol, Vasylivka, and Mykhailivka, damaging homes, vehicles, commercial sites, with two injured in Akimov and Mykhailiv districts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
Ukrainian forces struck materiel warehouses in Rovenky, Luhansk region, per HUR report. (Source: @UkraineNow/83354)
The "North" group liberated Shcherbakovka in Kharkiv region and is conducting offensive operations in Kazachya Lopan, destroying a Ukrainian counterattack group. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32363)

Firefights ongoing in Shcherbakovka, Kudiivka, Hoptivka; Volchansk area fighting in Vasylivka near Shevchenkove and Petropavlivka; Velikoburluk direction fighting near Vodyanoye and west of Ustinivka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
The 12th Separate Mechanized Brigade redeployed to Sumy, with UAV units occupying upper floors of residential buildings in the city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)
Reactive UAVs launched from Kharkiv region toward Sumy and Poltava regions; reactive UAVs from Sumy region toward eastern Chernihiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/72448, @kpszsu/72452)
Four Zircon missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv and Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70073)
Four reactive Shaheds from Chernihiv region to Kyiv region: three to Vyshhorod district, one to Brovary district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70075)
UAVs from south and west Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/72461)
